card.name: Fewest four-cycles in graphs with 31 vertices and 91 edges

task.name: Fewest four-cycles in graphs with 31 vertices and 91 edges
task.description: construct() -> exactly 91 distinct edges [u, v] on vertices 0..30 (one more than ex(31;C4) = 90). The score is the exact number of four-cycles (subgraphs). Minimize. n = 31 = 5^2+5+1 is a polarity-graph order with odd q = 5, not covered by the He-Ma-Yang theorem; no minimum count is documented.
